findings.detail: Cold Spring Brewing Company source amortized cost is $9,267 thousand, so stored cost 9267.0 is under-scaled and should be 9267000.0.

rationale: Class 2 row-level X07. The raw SOI row for Cold Spring Brewing Company reports amortized cost $9,267 and fair value $9,348 in the schedule, whose total investment line is in thousands. The stored cost value 9267.0 is therefore under-scaled relative to the source amount of 9267000.0, which can make a correctly scaled fair value appear to exceed 10x cost.
